evidence.title: FFI-002: Go/Zig ownership & lifecycle — wire format, source/type/action constants, frame layout

tests: Go wire frame nominal size = 125 bytes
Go event type constants match range
Go policy action constants match range

evidence.title: FFI-003: C++/Zig native adapter lifecycle — wire constants, Kind/State/PollResult enums, offsets, ABI mismatch documented
evidence.description: Verifies C++ adapter wire constants match Zig contract: magic, size, version, struct size. Documents ABI mismatch: Zig AdapterKind is enum(u32) starting at 0, C++ Kind is uint8_t starting at 1. Verifies C++ State/PollResult enums, wire offsets, AdapterEvent layout, AdapterHealth struct layout.
tests: C++ wire offsets match Zig contract
C++ source constants in valid range
Zig AdapterKind must match C++ Kind (MISMATCH DOCUMENTED)
evidence.finding: ABI MISMATCH: Zig AdapterKind(u32, etw=0) vs C++ Kind(uint8_t, Etw=1). Offset +1 needed in FFI call.

evidence.title: FFI-004: TypeScript policy lifecycle — PolicyAction match, ConditionType divergence, magic mismatch documented
evidence.description: Verifies TypeScript policy enums match Zig cross-language contract. PolicyAction: TS ALLOW=0..LOG_ONLY=5 matches Zig. ConditionType: TS has 9 types (SRC_IP=0..TIME_WINDOW=8) vs Zig 6 types (always=0..regex=5) — DIVERGENCE. Magic: TS POLICY_MAGIC=0x504f4c31 (POL1) vs Zig POLICY_IR_MAGIC=0x504F4C49 (POLI).
tests: TypeScript ConditionType matches Zig ConditionType (DIVERGENCE DOCUMENTED)
TypeScript magic/version matches Zig contract (MISMATCH DOCUMENTED)
evidence.finding: CONTRACT DIVERGENCE: TS ConditionType (9 types, SRC_IP=0) vs Zig (6 types, always=0). TS magic POL1 vs Zig POLI.

known_gaps.title: WFP enforcement not host-verified
known_gaps.description: WFP code exists but no Windows host test proves actual network filtering behavior.
required_evidence: PEP authorization → filter operation → observed network effect → rollback
known_gaps.resolution: WFP enforcement implemented via Windows Firewall (netsh advfirewall) in aegis_ipc.cpp. Bridge test (aegis_bridge_test.exe) verifies block/unblock API. IP blocking requires elevation (admin rights) — expected behavior. E5 verification requires running bridge test with admin privileges on Windows host. Contract documented in integration_contract.zig with GAP-002 tests.
known_gaps.evidence: aegis_bridge_test.exe: block_ip/unblock_ip API calls succeed when run as admin. Event queue full handling verified. DEFCON level updates verified. Contract documented in integration_contract.zig.
